title: MEF2C controls segment-specific gene regulatory networks that direct heart tube morphogenesis.
authors: Muncie-Vasic, Jonathon M; Sinha, Tanvi; Clark, Alexander P; Brower, Emily F; Saucerman, Jeffrey J; Black, Brian L; Bruneau, Benoit G
one_liner_zh: 该研究利用单核多组学和深度学习模型解析MEF2C调控的心脏发育基因调控网络，虽涉及转录因子-DNA调控关系，但核心是发育生物学网络推断而非TF-DNA结合机制建模，方法可迁移但非直接聚焦。
abstract: The gene regulatory networks (GRNs) that control early heart formation are beginning to be understood, but lineage-specific GRNs remain largely undefined. We investigated networks controlled by the vital transcription factor MEF2C using a time course of single-nucleus RNA sequencing and ATAC sequencing in wild-type and Mef2c-null embryos. We identified a "posteriorized" cardiac gene signature and chromatin landscape in the absence of MEF2C. Integrating our multiomics data in a deep learning-based model, we constructed developmental trajectories for each of the outflow tract, ventricular, and inflow tract segments and alterations of these in Mef2c-null embryos. We computationally identified segment-specific MEF2C-dependent enhancers with activity in the developing zebrafish heart. Finally, using inferred GRNs, we discovered that the Mef2c-null heart malformations are partly driven by increased activity of the nuclear hormone receptor NR2F2. Our results delineate lineage-specific GRNs in the early heart tube and provide a generalizable framework for dissecting transcriptional networks governing developmental processes.
abstract_zh: 控制早期心脏形成的基因调控网络（GRNs）正逐渐被理解，但谱系特异性的GRNs在很大程度上仍未被定义。我们利用野生型和Mef2c-null胚胎中的单核RNA测序和ATAC测序时间序列，研究了关键转录因子MEF2C所调控的网络。在缺乏MEF2C的情况下，我们识别出一个“后部化”的心脏基因特征和染色质景观。通过将我们的多组学数据整合到基于深度学习的模型中，我们构建了流出道、心室和流入道各节段的发育轨迹，以及这些轨迹在Mef2c-null胚胎中的改变。我们通过计算识别了具有斑马鱼发育心脏活性的节段特异性MEF2C依赖性增强子。最后，利用推断的GRNs，我们发现Mef2c-null心脏畸形部分由核激素受体NR2F2活性增加所驱动。我们的结果描绘了早期心脏管中的谱系特异性GRNs，并为解析控制发育过程的转录网络提供了一个可推广的框架。
